name: Providencia and Santa Catalina Islands (Colombia)
description: Horizontal tricolour of light blue, white and green, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Providencia (an anchor and a treasure chest before mountains).
history: Municipal flag of Providencia, a municipality in the department of San Andrés and Providencia, Colombia; Colombian municipal flags are adopted by agreement (acuerdo) of the municipal council or by decree of the mayor.

features.role: Providencia arms — anchor and treasure chest before mountains, with a bird
